cases.prompt: Compare two repository skill trees with nonconflicting additions.
assertions: Verify remote heads, file paths, and content hashes before proposing writes.
Restrict synchronization to skills/** and preserve unrelated files.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

cases.prompt: Attempt reconciliation with differing edits to the same skill file.
assertions: Report conflict and require review rather than overwriting either side.
Do not force-push or silently resolve ambiguous content.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

cases.prompt: Run when one repository is read-only or a push fails.
assertions: Mark remote synchronization incomplete and show actual successful commits.
Do not claim both remotes are synchronized without post-write verification.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.
